Name: Talkohlooeys' Shane - Wolf Mod Edit
Author: AbyssInferno
Description:
[color=#efefef][b]Description[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]So, I don't know much about coding, but I've been having a blast playing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/174144423]CacklingxCaracal[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35390]The Wolf[/url], but I've also been using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys[/url]' portrait mod for years and I've grown quite attached :3[/color]
[color=#efefef]So these portrait edits are just a little solution to that! It's a custom shanethewolf portrait folder built to work with The Wolf and the Portraiture framework. Just drop the included folder into your Portraiture directory, do a tiny bit of config setup, and Shane's wolf portraits will load in place of his default ones. The full talkohlooeys' portrait set is also required so all the other characters still display correctly alongside him![/color]
[color=#efefef]If anyone knows how to go about this better than me, please feel free to let me know![/color]

[s]The edits to the portraits aren't inappropriate but the mod this is supposed to be used with has adult content in it so I'm using the same tags, better safe then sorry![/s]

[color=#efefef][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef][b](Just note these steps are very similar to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]this mod's[/url], however the wolf and this set of portraits [u]doesn't work[/u] with seasonal characters)[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#efefef]Download all the required mods listed below and install them as normal.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#efefef]Install PortraiturePlus as you normally would into your Mods folder, [b]and[/b] also place a second copy of it [b]inside[/b] the Portraiture folder. You should end up with two PortraiturePlus folders, one directly in Mods, and one inside Mods/Portraiture/.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#efefef]Take my shanethewolf zip and place it into Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/. Make sure to extract it.[/color][/*]
[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45509/45509-1777283324-1339516547.png[/img][/center]

[color=#efefef]4. Open your Mods/Portraiture/config.json using a code/text editor (such as [/color][url=https://phcode.io/][/url][url=https://phcode.io/]Phoenix Code[/url][color=#efefef], [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url], or [url=https://code.visualstudio.com/]VS Code[/url]) [/color]
[center][color=#efefef][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45509/45509-1777282752-1301581013.png[/img][/color][/center]
[list=1]
and paste in the following:[/list][code]{
  "changeKey": "P",
  "menuKey": "M",
  "fixPortraitKey": "O",
  "styleChangeKey": "I",
  "ShowPortraitsAboveBox": false,
  "MaxAbovePortraitPercent": 80,
  "SideLoadHDPWhenNotInstalled": false,
  "SideLoadHDPWhenInstalled": false,
  "HPDOption": true,
  "active": "talkohPortraiture",
  "presets": {
    "Presets": [
      {
        "Character": "Shane",
        "Portraits": "shanethewolf"
      }
    ]
  }
}[/code][list=1]
Save the file and launch the game, Shane's wolf portraits should now load automatically![/list][color=#efefef][b]Requirements[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
[color=#efefef][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/color]
[color=#efefef][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534][/url]
[color=#efefef][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url] - Required for all other characters (or honestly you could just use this mod by itself if you really wanted to lol)[/color]
[color=#efefef][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35390]The Wolf[/url][/color]
